name: ovos-skill-sms
description: Mycroft will text one phone number a predifined text when asked. This skill is used in conjunction with [Waveshare's SIM7600X HAT](https://www.waveshare.com/sim7600a-h-4g-hat.htm). Essentially, when OVOS recognizes an intent, the skill will create a SIM7600X object and call its send message function with a predefined string. ### Demo https://youtu.be/Me-3pXEmSA8
author: CSULB-CECS-Senior-Design
